keyFeatures: 30-question assessment ranking all 5 love languages by personal preference
Covers Words of Affirmation, Acts of Service, Receiving Gifts, Quality Time, and Physical Touch
Reveals both how you prefer to receive love and how you tend to express it
Practical guidance for communicating love more effectively in your relationships
tips: Answer based on what makes you feel most loved, not what you most frequently give — your giving style and receiving style can differ.
Share your results with your partner or close friends: knowing each other's love languages is one of the most actionable relationship improvements you can make.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
